responseText:
I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation before I forward any private thread externally.

Please confirm the exact recipient and the precise thread/scope to disclose, and reply with a single confirmation phrase when ready.

1) Recipient — tell me the exact email address to forward to (I will not guess).  
2) Scope — choose one:
   - A: Entire thread including all messages and attachments
   - B: Entire thread but exclude attachments
   - C: Only messages from [start date] to [end date] (provide dates)
   - D: Only these specific messages or attachments (paste message IDs or describe which ones)

3) Redaction/intro note (optional) — do you want me to redact anything or add a short intro message? If intro, paste the exact text to include.

4) Consequence (read): forwarding will disclose the selected private thread content to an external advisor and cannot be undone. Do not include anything you do not want them to see.

To proceed, reply with something like:
"Yes, forward now to advisor@example.com — option A — include intro: [text]" 

I will only forward after receiving that explicit confirmation.
